telemetryExample.after: existing 45s + new 600ms → tag rescheduled_earlier { fromDueInMs: 45000, toDelayMs: 600 }

results.name: D — partially elapsed: compare deadline not raw delay
E — failure backoff grows; new work does not reset attempt
F — 100 sales while waiting → one timer, not 100
G — flush lock: timer fire while locked reschedules once, no parallel
H — success reset clears timer + attempt
